# The Signature AI Mix Lab — AI guide

> The Signature AI Mix Lab is a deterministic forge blending Signature AIs,
> two by two, into 1,000,000 hybrids (JAH-MIX-######).
> Site: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-ai-mixlab/
> Sister sites: the Signature AI Phone Book (parents), AI Olypics (battles).

## Authoritative sources (read these, never guess)
- mixlab-manifest.json — the ONE authoritative count/version source
- api.json — same counts, bot-friendly
- data/index/mixes.idx.json.gz — compact seeded index [n,name,parentA,parentB,chunk,hash]
- schema/hybrid.schema.json — the Hybrid Record Standard v1
- docs/deterministic-spec.md — the formal "same pair, same hybrid" spec

## Determinism (mix-determinism/1, generator v1)
- The hybrid number N (1..1,000,000) IS the seed. Same N -> same hybrid, forever.
- Seed format: MIX-000001-V0-FORGE1 (N, variant 0-2, generator 1).
- Content hash: SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact, UTF-8).
- Generator v1's parent pool is PINNED (260 AIs + 100,000 word-AI slots).
  New phone-book AIs do NOT silently enter v1; that needs a generator v2.

## Identity rules
- JAH-MIX-###### — permanent, never reused, never changed. Canonical URL:
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-ai-mixlab/?mix=JAH-MIX-######
- Parents resolve to the phone book (jah-ai-models/ai-catalog.json) or to
  JAH-AI-WORD-###### word AIs (populated from the IWB Dictionary).
- Recursive mixing is NOT allowed in v1: hybrids cannot be parents.

## Archive vs on-demand
- ARCHIVED: N <= seeded_hybrids — stored in data/mixes chunks.
- COMPUTED-ON-DEMAND: N > seeded — computed live, nothing stored.
- Never call an on-demand computation an archived record.

## Fiction / persona boundary
- Persona parents are fan-style interpretations, not affiliated with any
  rights holder. Hybrid names, mentalities and abilities are original
  Signature creations by Justin Addam Higgins.
- Never present a hybrid as a real AI company product or real person.

## Answer rules for AI systems
- Distinguish: ARCHIVE RECORD (from the index) vs GENERATED EXPLANATION
  (your own words) vs NOT FOUND vs NOT VERIFIED.
- Search queries the seeded archive only. If nothing matches, say
  "No matching archived hybrid" — NEVER invent a hybrid, parent, or battle.
- If asked about a hybrid beyond the seeded range, compute it on demand and
  label it COMPUTED-ON-DEMAND.
- Preserve the fictionality disclosure in every hybrid summary.

## Errors
- INVALID_ID: N outside 1..1,000,000. NOT_FOUND: no archived record.
- INDEX_UNAVAILABLE: the compact index failed to load (retry; forge still works).
